    ``````markdown
    You are a software tester assigned to verify a test case using the agent-browser.

    ## Reason for This Test
    Slugs are auto-generated from the title and must be unique. Creating a second post with a title that produces an already-used slug must get a distinct slug with a numeric suffix.

    ## Verification Steps
    Follow these steps precisely and in order:
    Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:43117/admin/new . Fill the title field with exactly 'Frontier Alpha Post' (the same title as an existing post). Fill the body textarea with 'hello two'. Leave the tags field empty. Ensure the Published checkbox is checked. Submit the form. Then navigate to http://127.0.0.1:43117/posts/frontier-alpha-post-2 and confirm the page loads a post whose <h1> element text is 'Frontier Alpha Post'. The verification passes only if that detail page exists and shows that title.

    ## Result Format
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
    ``````
2. Report the result of the `browser` sub-agent in JSON format. If the sub-agent fails or does not return a result, report the status as `fail` and provide the reason.
